page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features 56 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing 56 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are delivered by two integrated NVIDIA P4 GPUs, which provide a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The absence of local storage means that storage performance is dependent on the selected external block storage volumes, which should be factored into the overall architectural design.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge offers a dense allocation of dedicated compute cores and dual GPUs without the added cost of bundled local NVMe drives. This makes it a viable option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but rely on centralized or network-based storage. Suitable workloads include machine learning inference, video transcoding, parallel computing tasks, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated applications.
